report_name: Kendal Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP) 2022 - 2037
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) was used to identify the most popular cycle routes for both school and travel to work journeys within the district.
other_tools_developed: Prioritisation framework assessing effectiveness, alignment with policy objectives, economic factors, and deliverability.
specific_evidence_of_impact: A £2.3m allocation from the Local Growth Fund enabled delivery of part of the Kendal X project, which has been incorporated into the LCWIP.
pct_usage_quote: The most popular cycle routes [17] for both school and travel to work journeys within the district are all located within the urban area of Kendal.
